title: CVE-2026–58231: SAP Commerce Cloud Code Injection Vulnerability
content_md: Intro The August 2026 SAP security patch cycle represents a critical juncture for enterprise risk management, marked by the presence of a maximum-severity 10.0 CVSS score and a cluster of vulnerabilities that collectively threaten the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of core business systems. The aggregate risk spans SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII), and the NetWeaver/ABAP platform. This landscape requires a prioritized response to mitigate the potential for total technical impact and unauthorized lateral movement within the cloud and on-premise environments. The threat landscape is dominated by the “Critical Four” vulnerabilities: CVE-2026–58231 (CVSS 10.0): Code injection in SAP Commerce Cloud (Unauthenticated). CVE-2026–44772 (CVSS 9.9): Code injection in SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (Low Privilege). CVE-2026–34265 (CVSS 9.8): Out-of-bounds write in SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform (Unauthenticated). CVE-2026–44758 (CVSS 9.1): Code injection in SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (High Privilege). While the 10.0 and 9.8 flaws are unauthenticated and pose an immediate external threat to internet-facing postures, the Manufacturing flaws (9.9 and 9.1) highlight a severe risk of lateral movement and privilege escalation by authenticated users.
